ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A small display for video calling does not address a clear need in my current TV and camera setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a 4K Fire TV Stick and a Fire TV television, so this HD stick feels redundant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this as a useful spare for connecting equipment to my 4K television, with extra reach for placement.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An older standalone Alexa speaker adds little to the TV controls I already use.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on watching television and recording video; I am not looking for a video-calling display.
ItemID: NA; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Storage and transferring footage fit my camcorder use, but I would check the card format and camera compatibility before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have several ways to watch content and do not currently need another screen.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiarity with Fire TV does not give me a strong reason to add a separate smart speaker.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am interested in connected cameras and television equipment, but have no specific appliance I want to automate right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would pass because a newer Alexa speaker still does not fill a clear gap in my current setup.
